entry.title: New: dsh-project-manager
entry.summary: Manage development projects from the DSH web UI in a draggable floating window: add/remove, one-click start/stop/restart, hot-reload restart on file changes, and real-time persistent logs. Exact install spec: github:br1nosense/dsh-project-manager. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
